title: mypos
description: this mod returns your coordinates to you when you type mypos.
body:
## (About mypos)

I first had the idea for this mod when I was a kid playing Minecraft. Back then, I didn't have the tools or the knowledge to solve the problem of sharing coordinates easily.

Now, at 15, I finally have my own laptop and the skills to make it happen.and its my first step to learning a real language like java.
## (The Philosophy)

 **"Do one thing, do it well."**

mypos is a generic utility designed to be lightweight, secure, and be impossible to make a mess. It should do exactly what it says on the tin: swaps a keyword(mypos) for your location. Nothing more, nothing less.

## (A Note on the Journey)

I’ll be honest: I grew up playing on "alternative" versions of the game because my parents didn't see the point in buying it. I plan to get an authentic copy as soon as I’m at Uni and have my own income. Until then, I'm contributing to the community with code.

## (bug reports)
please, please don't report bugs here if you can, i don't watch the comments often, i have exams. and having to diagnose a bug in comments is a nightmare, heres the github issue page: [GitHub](https://github.com/allen-wang-2001/mypos/issues)

_p.s. i know the profile image for this project is AI generated, and no i will not listen to your complaints about real art. im a 15 year old and has neither the skills to make it myself nor the money to employ someonone on fivver._
